newsitem.title: FINLAND: Helsinki seen starting mixed with Nokia dragging.
newsitem.headline: Helsinki seen starting mixed with Nokia dragging.

text.p: Shares were seen opening mixed, with the main indices expected to be flat or lower as Nokia fell on Wall Street although U.S. stocks rose, brokers said.
"I don't expect much of a rise today," one broker said, while another said Nokia would drag the overall trend lower.
Nokia's New York traded ADR closed down $1-1/2 at the equivalent of about 414.00 markka, or 4.00 markka below its Helsinki close.
Forestries were seen having an upside after U.S. paper stocks had added to recent gains overnight.
Brokers said trading activity could begin to wind down for the weekend, and that overseas investors were likely to continue playing the leading role they have had in recent weeks.
